## CCSupport (iOS 18 fix)

**Keeps your Control Center modules after Safe Mode and reboots on iOS 18.** This is opa334's CCSupport, the tweak that lets other tweaks add Control Center modules, with one fix.

- **The problem:** on iOS 18, every time your phone starts without tweaks (Safe Mode, or a reboot before you jailbreak again), iOS removes the tweak modules from Control Center.
- **The fix:** your Control Center layout is kept in its own file, so the modules stay.
- After installing, add your modules back one last time.
- Everything else is CCSupport as you know it.

- **iOS 18 to 27.** Rootless jailbreaks.
- On iOS 17 and older, keep opa334's CCSupport. This one won't install there.
- Tested on iOS 18 with Dopamine.
- When opa334 releases an official update, it replaces this one automatically.
- If it ever sends your phone to Safe Mode, open Sileo (it still works there) and uninstall it. Then [tell me](https://github.com/Jond-ie/repo/issues).

**CCSupport** by **opa334 (Lars Fröder)**, MIT licence (included in the package). iOS 18 fix by **Jond-ie**, sent to opa334: [opa334/CCSupport#26](https://github.com/opa334/CCSupport/pull/26). Source: [Jond-ie/CCSupport](https://github.com/Jond-ie/CCSupport/tree/ios18-iconstate).
